title: The Tree by the Water
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler whose gift is quiet courage, and tonight trusting Heavenly Father when nothing looks easy is its own kind of brave, the same brave Beau shows when rain shuts the playground and he still feeds the fish and sings.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because trusting quietly, when nothing looks easy, is its own kind of brave. In Beau's world today: it was a hard day, and rain shut down the whole playground. His best friend stayed home sick. Beau still fed the class fish and still sang at circle time, doing the good small things anyway. Just like the tree with roots down in the river, Beau learned that trusting Heavenly Father keeps us green on dry days.
